new_lens_seeds.title: Host-Parasite Operator Network

new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed. The mechanism is strong but sensitive and cross-cutting; public work should first compare it against existing Power, Secret Society, Proximity Games, Taboo, and Prediction surfaces and avoid creating a standalone Epstein or ethnic-conspiracy page.
